scripts.synth: bash -c 'source ../../scripts/project-variables.sh && unset AWS_PROFILE && cdk synth --context stage=staging'
scripts.diff:staging: bash -c 'source ../../scripts/project-variables.sh && unset AWS_PROFILE && cdk diff --all --context stage=staging'
scripts.diff:prod: bash -c 'source ../../scripts/project-variables.sh && unset AWS_PROFILE && cdk diff --all --context stage=prod'
scripts.deploy:staging: bash -c 'source ../../scripts/project-variables.sh && unset AWS_PROFILE && cdk deploy --all --context stage=staging --require-approval never'
scripts.deploy:prod: bash -c 'source ../../scripts/project-variables.sh && unset AWS_PROFILE && cdk deploy --all --context stage=prod --require-approval broadening'
scripts.destroy:staging: bash -c 'source ../../scripts/project-variables.sh && unset AWS_PROFILE && cdk destroy --all --context stage=staging --force'
scripts.bootstrap: bash -c 'source ../../scripts/project-variables.sh && unset AWS_PROFILE && cdk bootstrap --context stage=staging'
